brand.tagline: The Hub's second Lock to Earn project — a dry run while terms are agreed with the POKEAHOE team.

items.label: Funding wallet
items.rule: project.fundingWallet is set and is not one of project.operatorWallets

items.label: Program version
items.rule: a program version is in force and its hash verifies (lib/hub/project.verifyVersionHash)

items.label: On-chain commitment
items.rule: Addendum B5's on-chain memo commitment has not been recorded for this version — the calculation is reproducible from the published inputs, not independently verified

items.label: Reward asset
items.detail: the reward asset matches the locked mint

items.label: Term range
items.rule: 1 <= minDurationDays <= maxTermDays <= 3650 — the same bound lib/hub/project.validateTerms enforces at publish

items.label: Reward budget
items.detail: coverage 0.00x of what is owed plus the coming period (owed 0 + projected 1000000000 raw) — about 0 day(s) of runway at the last observed balance
items.rule: coverage = observedBalanceRaw / (obligationsRaw + next-period projected obligation); block when coverage < 1

items.label: Dry run
items.rule: project.access.note is labelled a dry run

funding.note: an observed balance is not reserved funding; a scheduled unlock is not funding
